section-2.subTitle: Fresh Seafood marinated in soy sauce, new batch every day
section-2.title: Authentic Freshness, 100% Preservative-Free

description.text1: At Co Thao Tom Ca, we only work with premium seafood, ensuring every ingredient meets the highest standard of freshness.
description.text2: In our kitchen, all ingredients are sourced from the finest suppliers. From Norwegian salmon, Ca Mau crab, Phan Thiet blue crab, and fresh farm-raised shrimp, to Korean abalone, free-range eggs, and even the smallest components — everything is carefully selected, prepared fresh daily, and never treated with preservatives.
description.text3: Our signature soy sauce is crafted based on an authentic Korean recipe, thoughtfully adjusted to suit Vietnamese taste — it is deeply flavorful while maintaining a refreshing lightness, completely oil-free, allowing the natural sweetness of every cut to stand out.
description.text4: "Fresh batch, every day" is not just a phrase, but a core standard at Co Thao Tom Ca — freshness is not a choice, it is a requirement.

section-3.title: Why choose Co Thao Tom Ca?

title.text1: Aged to perfection, delivered at its peak

description.text1: With a network of 5 branches dedicated to delivery, Co Thao Tom Ca ensures optimal speed and quality in every order. We place great care in our packaging process, designed to preserve each dish from the effects of temperature and transit time — delivering a complete, premium experience to every meal.

section-2.title: Rooted in respect for pure ingredients
section-2.subTitle: Becoming a pioneer and market leader in fresh seafood marinated in rich sauce

description.text1: It all began with a deep appreciation for salmon — one of the most nutritionally rich and refined ingredients in culinary culture.
description.text2: From this perspective, we gradually explored the world of Korean-style soy-marinated seafood — where each ingredient is not merely a component, but the foundation of the dish itself. We came to realize that a truly authentic marinade is not defined by seasoning alone, but by the freshness, purity, and intrinsic quality of every ingredient.
description.text3: Co Thao Tom Ca was built upon this belief. We do not pursue mass production or extended preservation. Instead, we embrace a handcrafted approach, preparing only limited fresh batches each day to preserve the natural firmness and delicate sweetness of premium-grade seafood — just as it is meant to be.

value1.title: Premium-Grade Ingredients
value1.description: We use only Grade-1 ingredients, with a 100% no-preservatives commitment to preserve their authentic, natural flavors.

value2.title: Professional & Safe
value2.description: Every step of the preparation process is done by hand by our professionally trained team, in strict compliance with food safety and hygiene standards. Our kitchen and equipment are kept sanitized, clean, and safe at every step.

value3.title: Freshness, True to Taste
value3.description: Our seafood retains its freshness, succulence, and natural sweetness. Paired with our signature house-made soy marinade, every dish delivers a distinctive flavor profile.

value4.title: Attentive & Dedicated
value4.description: A complete meal goes beyond just great food. At Co Thao Tom Ca, we put genuine care into every touchpoint, delivering not only quality dishes but also a thoughtful and reassuring dining experience.

section-5.description: Whether you are an office worker looking for a rich dinner, or a family in need of a delicious change of pace, Co Thao Tom Ca's Kitchen is always open to welcome you.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: Co Thao Tom Ca Kitchen is always ready to answer any of your questions. With our utmost care and enthusiasm, if you need flavor recommendations or help picking the perfect dish for today, don't hesitate to reach out to us right away!
